title: Org Pulse: compact agenda + draft OKRs for company sync
body:
Purpose
---
Quick, high-bandwidth agenda and OKR alignment doc for the Org Pulse (compact company sync). This is a short-format replaceable all-hands we want to run monthly in Q2 to keep cross-functional tradeoffs visible and to surface asks that need exec attention. Draft below includes proposed objectives, proposed KRs, rough timings for a 45 minute session, and pre-read + follow-up plan.

Notes to self / what this doc is NOT
- NOT the full Q2 OKR set (those live in the OKR tracker). This is the condensed company-level slice for the sync.
- Rough language — feel free to edit phrasing for clarity.
- We will iterate before Friday leadership review.

Proposed high-level objective for the Org Pulse
- Keep the company aligned on 3 cross-cutting operational outcomes for the quarter: latency reliability, Dedicated ramp, and enterprise security/compliance readiness.

Draft company-level OKRs (compact) — Q2 draft
O1: Make the Redwood platform predictable for customers (latency/cost)
  KR1.1: Reduce p99 generation latency for the hosted API by 18% on 50-token baseline (measured across top 10 models)
  KR1.2: Increase cache hit rate for prefix caching by 25% across typical chat workloads (tracked per-customer sample set)
  KR1.3: Publish unit-cost playbook and two example workloads that realize >=20% cost improvement vs Jan baseline

O2: Expand Dedicated capacity adoption for mid-market customers
  KR2.1: Close 6 Dedicated contracts with committed monthly throughput >= X tokens (sales target placeholder)
  KR2.2: Reduce Dedicated onboarding time from contract signature to prod by 35% (tracked via onboarding funnel)
  KR2.3: Ship two autoscaling policy presets + docs that reduce manual ops requests by 40%

O3: Harden Private (VPC/on-prem) for regulated customers
  KR3.1: Achieve SOC2 readiness checklist completion for Private baseline (internal audit pass on 80% items)
  KR3.2: Deliver KMS/HSM integration guide and one validated customer POC in EMEA
  KR3.3: Launch audit-log streaming feature with retention controls and perf targets

Agenda (45 minutes)
- 0:00–0:05 Opening: quick context & goals (CEO)
- 0:05–0:15 Exec highlight: what changed vs last month (ops snapshot; SRE + infra)
- 0:15–0:27 Focus segment: Dedicated ramp roadmap (product + sales) — 10 min presentation + 2 min live Qs
- 0:27–0:36 Focus segment: Private deployment compliance update (security) — 6 min + 3 min Qs
- 0:36–0:42 Cross-functional asks and prioritization (moderated)
- 0:42–0:45 Final decisions / next steps (rolloffs + owners)

Pre-read (to be shared 48 hours before)
- One-pager: current metrics snapshot (latency, cost, Dedicated pipeline) — Marcus to assemble (spreadsheet + 2 slide summary)
- Risk digest: top 3 runbooks that might require cross-team exec decisions (SRE to summarize)
- Short FAQ/definitions: what we mean by "Dedicated ramp", "Private baseline" (product ops)

Key asks to surface for the meeting (working list — please add)
- Product: need decision on whether to prioritize auto-eviction cache policy for low-latency tier this sprint (impact: small latency wins but increases mem by 12%). Owner: Priya.
- Sales: request expedited Dedicated onboarding pilot for two named mid-market accounts (need thumbs up on temporary quota reallocation). Owner: Sofia.
- Security: ask for additional 0.5 FTE from Eng infra to complete KMS/HSM interop validation before end of quarter. Owner: Liam.

Unresolved tradeoffs & discussion points (notes)
- Quantization vs accuracy: engineering suggests aggressive 4-bit profiles will reduce costs by ~30% but may regress on customer-behavior prompts. Need to propose a rollback plan or canary metric set.
- SLA tiers: do we introduce a new "business" latency SLA that routes to Dedicated by default? Pros/cons listed in linked Confluence.
- Communication cadence: monthly Org Pulse vs biweekly team-level sync — tradeoff between visibility and meeting overload. Proposed pilot: monthly for org-level, weekly for core infra pod.

Follow-up / action owner matrix (post-meeting)
- Publish outcome notes & decision log within 24 hours — Owner: Hannah
- Update OKR tracker with final KR language — Owner: Product Ops (Marcus)
- Create comms draft for customers if we change routing behavior — Owner: Growth comms (TBD)

Execution risks and mitigations (short)
- Risk: Dedicated onboarding bottleneck (eng capacity) — Mitigation: create templated deployment bundle and two-hour SOW for partners; escalate to VP Eng if pilot backlog grows beyond 3 customers.
- Risk: Regressions from quantization — Mitigation: define explicit revert triggers and add evo tests to eval harness.

Meeting logistics & run of show (practical)
- Format: remote-first with a small in-person seat at HQ for leadership; slide limit: 3 slides per segment.
- Moderator: Hannah (will timebox)
- Recording & transcript: auto-post to #all-hands and Confluence page.
- Slide template: use company pulse template in Drive (linked in artifacts).

Open questions for leadership review (prior to Friday)
- Approve the three compact company OKRs above? (Yes/No — prefer edits inline)
- Approve 45 minute format? (Yes/No)
- Approve proposed ask of 0.5 FTE from infra to security validation?

Quick draft comms snippet (for review)
- Subject: Org Pulse — compact monthly sync (what, why, when)
- Body preview: "This month’s Org Pulse focuses on predictability: latency, Dedicated adoption, and Private compliance. Join us to hear short updates, help prioritize cross-team asks, and review a compact set of company-level OKRs. Pre-read and slide pack linked."

Notes & small TODOs (Hannah)
- Pull latency numbers by EOD Wed (Marcus)
- Ask SRE for one short inc/alert summary (Liam)
- Draft comms + registration form (Sofia)

References / quick links
- Confluence Org Pulse page (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ORG-PULSE-2026-Q2
- OKR tracker: https://docs.redwood.ai/okrs/2026/q2 (placeholder)
- Ticket: ORG-1423 (dedicated onboarding template)

Footer
- This is intentionally compact to keep the sync nimble. If you have strong opinions about the shape of the meeting or the OKRs, please add comments inline or ping in #exec-sync.
